title: Report to the Honorable Steven H. Schiff, House of Representatives: Government Records, Results of a Search for Records Concerning the 1947 Crash Near Roswell, New Mexico, July 28, 1995
doc_notes: This is a General Accounting Office (GAO) report investigating the availability of government records concerning the 1947 Roswell incident; it contains no reports of UAP encounters, only administrative documentation regarding the search for records and the military's explanation of the event as a weather balloon or Project Mogul balloon.
